kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَيْرُوتِيّ • (bayrūtiyy) (feminine بَيْرُوتِيَّة (bayrūtiyya), masculine plural بَيْرُوتِيُّون (bayrūtiyyūn), feminine plural بَيْرُوتِيَّات (bayrūtiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic بَيْرُوت (bayrūt)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic بيروتي
From بَيْرُوت (bayrūt, “Beirut”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: Beiruti (of, from or relating to the city of Beirut, Beirut Governorate, Lebanon)
